scope: Scoped static boundary checker and physical metadata graph; neither installed/global acceptance nor product/release/CI/PG approval.

findings.title: Reached nonRoot manifest drops physically installed registry/alias dependency closures
findings.expected: FAIL when declared dependency closure reaches products
findings.actual: PASS; passed=true; empty violations and diagnostics; native CLI exit 0
findings.rootCause: manifestEdges only consults workspaces.get(targetName) for every non-file/link specifier; if absent, no edge, physical package lookup, recursive governance or unknown diagnostic is emitted. A governed installed package can therefore lose its installed successor and the successor product dependency.
findings.reproduction: installed-source-dependency-transitive: core imports external-entry; its physical package.json declares external-next@1.0.0; physical external-next declares @inert/consumer. The native API and CLI report PASS (edgeCount=4). Eight further nested/dist registry and npmalias cases reproduce all four fields.
findings.impact: Manifest dependencies are specified graph edges; a complete and physically present declared core-to-product metadata path disappears, permitting false isolation certification.
findings.remediation: Resolve reached nonRoot registry and npmalias dependencies to canonical physical manifest identity in the correct declaring actor context, recursively preserve metadata edges/cycles, and block any unresolved frontier. Do not execute package entrypoints or add vendor/reflection exemptions.

findings.title: Explicit workspace dependency with no target produces false PASS
findings.expected: INCOMPLETE with reachable diagnostic bound to declaring manifest
findings.actual: PASS; passed=true; empty diagnostics; native CLI exit 0
findings.rootCause: The same missing workspaces lookup has no negative branch. @inert/missing:workspace:* is accepted as a string, then discarded despite its absent workspace.
findings.reproduction: Reached auxiliary/actor/dist/package.json declares @inert/missing:workspace:* in each of dependencies/devDependencies/optionalDependencies/peerDependencies. All four API and CLI cases return PASS.
findings.impact: An explicitly local workspace frontier cannot be adjudicated as external/irrelevant; absence is unknown and must remain blocking.
findings.remediation: Diagnose unmatched explicit workspace references on reached manifests; retain declaring physical manifest provenance and mark INCOMPLETE. Preserve root-ancestry documentary limits.
